Engineering behind Boutique Empresarial: Static Architecture, SDD and Agentic development

The video shows the engineering behind the Boutique Empresarial site: a unique conversion funnel, a static and fast basis, specification-oriented development, AI subagents, a quality gate that blocks any error and a design without unnecessary movement.

A simple site on the outside

At first glance, the Boutique Empresarial website is a minimalist page. Below, there is a conversion system built, tested and maintained almost entirely by an AI-guided architecture 00:00. The video uses the image of an iceberg: it begins from the visible tip and descends to where agents work 00:21.

A unique funnel

The project exists for a reason: there are no menus or endless pages. All leads to one journey 01:02. Her center is a seven-step form for free diagnosis, which qualifies contact 01:24.

Thus, the system filters and qualifies contact before any conversation with a person, and the team saves hours of manual triage 01:46.

A minimum and fast base

There are no heavy frameworks or large libraries in the browser. Base is HTML and static CSS 02:07. With Vite and Tailwind CSS, and hosting at AWS on S3 and CloudFront, pages load in milliseconds 02:27.

Specification-oriented development

Decisions are made before writing the code 03:07. In specification-oriented development (SDD), the documentation folder is the code law: when the requirement changes, the documentation changes first without exception 03:07.

It takes the guesswork out for both people and AI. 03:29. Repository documents say: "Documentation is the source of truth" 03:29.

The site is also made for AI agents. While people read HTML, search engines with AI read structured files such as llms.txt and WebMCP manifests 04:10. It's called the AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) 04:30.

The wake of AI agents

The vibe coding here is not letting AI improvise 04:51. The AI executes detailed contracts and specifications; the rules come from documentation 05:11.

At Claude Code, the work is divided between five specialized subagents 05:32:

  • one reads the page 05:32;
  • one fixes the code header 05:32;
  • one writes texts focusing on SEO 05:32;
  • one creates test suites 05:32;
  • one wheel final quality check 05:53.

The Quality Gate

No agent, human or AI, gives a task to be completed before the validation command turns green 06:14. It builds the site, runs tests on three browsers and requires zero accessibility violations 06:35. The template is failed-closed: any error for the process 06:35.

After the merge in the main branch, the pipeline runs the tests, builds, authenticates in the cloud, uploads the files and clears the old cache 06:56. Deploy is all automatic, and that's what lets AI speed get to the user without breaking anything 06:56.

Design: silence and elegance

The institutional site uses a cream background, a dark ink color typography and a thin gold line to mark the hierarchy 07:38. Social media materials have their own palette, more vibrant, and the two palettes never mix 07:59.

The site does not use background video, animations that distract or scroll with parallax effect 08:19. The movement only appears as a response to a user action, and this also helps fast loading 08:19.

Frequently Asked Questions

What happens if a test fails?

The process stops. The quality gate is failed, and no task is given by completion until the command turns green 06:35.

Why doesn't the site use animations?

To maintain clarity and speed. The movement only appears as a response to a user action 08:19.

About the video

In this video, we present the software engineering and the agency methodology used in the development of the site of **Boutique Empresarial**.

Follow how we combine high web performance (static MPA with less than 1 second load), specification-oriented development (SDD), multi-agent automation and preparation for AI engines and AI agents (AEO/WebMCP).

** WHAT YOU'LL SEE IN THIS VIDEO **

1. **Static Architecture & Single Funnel:**
Construction of a static Multi-Page Application (MPA) using Vite 6, Tailwind CSS v4 and pure HTML/CSS without hydration or heavy JS frameworks in the customer. Total focus on a unique conversion funnel (Free Diagnosis Landing Page → 7-step conversational form → Confirmation page).

2. **Specification Driven Development (SDD) & VibeCoded:**
Understand how 'docs/specs/' specifications work as the unique source of truth before any code change, allowing a quick implementation flow guided by clear contracts.

3. **Multi-Agent Pipeline (Claude Code):**
The agency structure of the project with specialized subagents (`page-auditor`, `head-fixer`, `copy-writer`, `test-author`, `gate-runner`), following the principle: *" expensive model decides, cheap model executes, the gate arbitri"*.

4. **Quality Gate (Fail-Closed):**
The operation of the 'npm run gate' command, which performs Vite build, E2E cross-browser tests with Playwright and WCAG 2.1 accessibility audit AA via 'axe-core'.

5. **CI/CD Automated in AWS via OIDC:**
The DevOps flow in GitHub Actions with temporary JWT authentication (no fixed keys) integrated into AWS S3, CloudFront Functions and Route 53.

6. **AEO & Discovered by AI Agents:**
As the site is structured for machine-readable content with `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, manifests in `/.well-known/`, HTTP Link headers (RFC 8288), DNS-AID and runtime WebMCP (`navigator.modelContext`) records.
